title: Feature
description: Something a character gains from a class, a subclass, a species, a background, a feat or an item. One model for all of them, because they differ only in where they come from, which `source` records. The 5e SRD keeps class features and species traits in separate collections; both land here.

grantedBy.description: The classes, subclasses, species or backgrounds that grant it. A species trait such as darkvision is shared by several species.

level.description: The level at which it is gained, for a class or subclass feature.

spells.description: Spells the feature grants, and how often they may be cast.

proficiencyChoices.description: Proficiencies the feature lets a character choose.

speed.description: A speed the feature sets, where it does.
